about: Fixed probe set of the TapeAPI spot-check tool. Every request body is sent exactly as written here, with {{model}} replaced by the --model value (and, for openai-chat, max_tokens optionally renamed with --chat-max-field). A new text or body means a new version. `records` names the record fields (dotted paths) each probe fills. Expected token counts are of tokenText alone (no chat template), computed with the pinned tokenizer files listed under tokenizers.pins; node tokenizers.mjs check recomputes them.

probes.purpose: Baseline for the token probes: the instruction alone. Its reported prompt tokens are the service's fixed overhead (chat template, hidden system prompt) plus the instruction.
